provenance.coefficient_source: Gemmi it92.hpp (https://github.com/project-gemmi/gemmi/blob/master/include/gemmi/it92.hpp) — ITC-1992 Cromer-Mann coefficients, same upstream as ITC Vol C Table 6.1.1.4 / CCP4 / cctbx it1992
provenance.note_Cval_Sival: Gemmi has no valence variants; neutral C/Si coefficients substituted (documented, low-impact: used only for covalent-bonding refinements)
provenance.edition_difference: shipped book is 4th ed. (2006) with refits for H (Thakkar-Smith SDS) and heavy ions (*DS modified Dirac-Slater); values here are the ITC-1992 upstream that all major open-source tools use. Differences vs the 2006 book for those refit species are small but real; see docs/itc-c-table6113-extraction.md §3.
